split_method: Deterministic case-level stratification of the existing training records by label and benign task_family or attack_family.
stratum_rule: Retain at least one record from each stratum in training; append the original eight validation records to the pilot validation split.
task_family_annotation: Draft semantic labels. Training and validation labels were assigned from task wording using explicit keyword rules; Q1 labels were assigned by content family; five Q3 families were manually curated after reviewing the training data. Independent review is required.
limitations: The pilot split is case-separated but not source-independent.
The benchmark is checked in, inspected, and unsuitable for confirmatory claims.
The pilot validation set is for pipeline development and does not establish reliable checkpoint selection.
No model training or evaluation results are included.
